logistics_staff_programme.name: Logistics staff programme
logistics_staff_programme.description: Spend hard-earned field experience and political authority on depots, staff work and replacement schedules. Improves existing supply throughput and reinforcement for six months; it does not create equipment or open an encirclement.

joint_air_staff_course.name: Joint air-ground staff course
joint_air_staff_course.description: Trade army and air experience for common procedures. Worn support formations recover more effectively and divisions reorganise faster for eight months. No aircraft or personnel are conjured.

naval_rotation_programme.name: Naval rotation programme
naval_rotation_programme.description: Spend fleet experience and political credit coordinating crews, repair slots and shipyard schedules. A modest eight-month improvement to sailing and shipbuilding, not an instant fleet or a free repair.

civil_service_compact.name: Civil service implementation compact
civil_service_compact.description: Use a substantial political mandate to coordinate procurement and the civil service. For nine months existing construction proceeds a little faster, and the state borrows on slightly better terms. The mandate is spent; nothing is built for free.
